notes: Uses the 90-minute drive to the larger airport (rule 3).

responses.value: I'd look at airlines and routes, local passengers who use a bigger airport, landing fees and incentives, and road and rail access. I'd start with routes and seats per week for three years, since passengers come from the flights airlines choose to run here.
Leakage: many locals drive 90 minutes to the larger airport, so winning them back could add much of the 30%.
